title: AutoMIL: Automated Multiple Instance Learning for Whole-Slide Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.32452v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Developing multiple instance learning pipelines for the classification of whole-slide images involves many interdependent design decisions and expertise in both pathology and machine learning. We present AutoMIL, an open-source framework that applies principles from the field of automated machine learning to tackle this task by automating integral pipeline steps, such as preprocessing, training and evaluation. In a benchmark evaluation with default settings, AutoMIL reached ROC-AUC scores of 0.94 on UBC-OCEAN, 0.99 on PCam and 0.93-0.96 on a TCGA-NSCLC subset, comparable to specialised pipelines in related work. Ensembling mainly improved performance on imbalanced data, showing that an automated pipeline must adapt to dataset characteristics. AutoMIL thus provides an accessible baseline for whole-slide image classification without manual pipeline configuration.

translated_title: AutoMIL：用于全切片图像分类的自动化多示例学习
translated_abstract: 开发用于全切片图像分类的多示例学习流程涉及许多相互关联的设计决策，并且需要病理学和机器学习两个领域的专业知识。我们提出了AutoMIL，这是一个开源框架，它应用自动机器学习领域的原理，通过自动化流程中的关键步骤（如预处理、训练和评估）来解决这一任务。在使用默认设置的基准评估中，AutoMIL在UBC-OCEAN数据集上达到了0.94的ROC-AUC分数，在PCam上达到了0.99，在TCGA-NSCLC子集上达到了0.93-0.96，与相关工作中的专用流程相当。集成方法主要提高了在不平衡数据上的性能，这表明自动化流程必须适应数据集的特性。因此，AutoMIL为全切片图像分类提供了一个无需手动配置流程的易用基线。
tldr: AutoMIL是一个开源的自动机器学习框架，通过自动化预处理、训练和评估等关键流程步骤，在无需手动配置的情况下实现了与专用流程相当性能的全切片图像分类基线。
en_tdlr: AutoMIL is an open-source automated machine learning framework that automates key pipeline steps such as preprocessing, training, and evaluation, providing an accessible baseline for whole-slide image classification with performance comparable to specialized pipelines, all without manual configuration.
